transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, my name is Tom, how can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My smart door lock keeps disconnecting from the app so I cannot lock it remotely.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry to hear that, Elena. Let's sort it out. First, to verify the account, can I get your account number, PIN, and the name on the account?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure, account 771-330-118, PIN 5521, name Elena.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, Elena, that all matches, you're verified.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great, thanks.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So just to confirm I understand correctly: your smart lock keeps losing its app connection so remote locking fails, Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I appreciate your patience, Elena. Let me dig into this for you properly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is the lock within good WiFi range of your router or a hub?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is fairly far from the router, near the front door.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: How are the batteries, has it warned you about low power?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Come to think of it, it did show a low battery warning.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Low batteries are a very common cause of connection drops on smart locks. Do you have fresh batteries to swap in?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, let me replace them... okay, done.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great, now let us re-pair it to the hub to restore a clean connection.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Alright, re-pairing now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you tell me exactly what you see on the door lock when the problem happens?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It just shows the same issue, nothing obvious changes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: How long has the door lock been set up in your home?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: About a year and a half now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have you made any changes recently, like an app update or a new router?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Now that you mention it, the app did update last week.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, that's useful. Let's start with a power cycle. Can you unplug it for about 30 seconds and plug it back in?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, unplugging it now... and it's back on.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Once it boots, do the status lights look normal, or is anything blinking oddly?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: There's a slow blinking amber light.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A slow amber usually means it's trying to reconnect. Let's check the app pairing next. Can you open the app and go to device settings?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm in device settings now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Do you see the firmware version listed there?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it says version 4.2.1.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's one version behind. Let's push the latest firmware. Tap 'Check for updates' for me.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's downloading now... okay it says installing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, let that finish, it can take a couple of minutes. While it does, can you confirm your home WiFi is on the 2.4 gigahertz band for this device?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I think so, but I'm not totally sure.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No problem, I can guide you. In the app, the network name shown should not end in '-5G'. What does it say?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It just says our normal network name, no 5G.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good, that's the right band. Has the firmware finished installing?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it just rebooted and the light is solid white now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent, solid white is what we want. Let's verify the connection quality. In the app, is there a signal strength indicator?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It shows two out of four bars.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Two bars can cause exactly the symptoms you described. How far is the device from your router?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Probably two rooms away, through a couple of walls.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That distance combined with walls explains the weak signal. Do you have the option to move it closer, even temporarily to test?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure, let me bring it near the router... okay it's next to it now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now how many bars is it showing?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, it jumped to four bars.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms it was a signal issue. Let's re-run the original action now and see if the problem repeats.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, trying it now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What happens this time?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It actually worked correctly that time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great sign. To make this permanent, I'd recommend a WiFi extender or moving the router, but let's first make sure the settings are optimal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: In advanced settings, can you make sure 'power saving mode' is turned off? It sometimes causes drop-offs.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Found it... it was on. I've turned it off now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That was likely contributing too. Let me also refresh the account provisioning from my side.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Alright.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: While that refreshes, can you tell me which operating system your phone runs, iOS or Android?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's an Android phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. And is the app itself up to date in the Play Store?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me check... there was an update, I've installed it now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Let's clear the app cache too, that clears out stale connection data. Can you go to app info and tap clear cache?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Done, cache cleared.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now please sign out of the app and sign back in so it re-authenticates cleanly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, signed out... and back in now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Does the door lock appear in your device list now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's showing up again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good. Let's check your router's connected-devices page to confirm it has a stable lease. Can you log into your router admin?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm logged in.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Do you see the door lock listed with an IP address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it has an IP listed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there an option to reserve that IP so it doesn't change? A changing address can cause disconnects.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Found it, I've reserved the IP now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent, that will help stability a lot. Let me run a quick diagnostic ping from our side.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The ping is coming back clean now, no packet loss. How does it look on your end?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Looks stable so far, no issues.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let's stress it a little to be sure. Can you trigger the feature a few times in a row?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Trying it several times... all good each time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's really encouraging. Let me also check there are no outages logged in your area.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No outages on record, so this was device-side, which we've now addressed. Are you seeing any warnings at all in the app?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No warnings, it's all green.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. Let me note everything we did on your ticket so any future call has the full history.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's helpful, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just so you have it, the ticket reference is 4471-QA. Would you like me to email a summary of the steps?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes please, that would be great.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Done, the summary is on its way to the email on file. Let's do a final check together.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I've pushed the fix from my end and refreshed the configuration.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Alright.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, that should do it. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait, is it actually fixed? ...Hello?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else I can help you with? If not, thank you for choosing S-Net, have a great day.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No that's all, bye.
